# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Layered, single-module Android app (`app/`) with no DI framework — `ui/` (Compose screens +
per-screen ViewModels) depends on `domain/` (plain Kotlin business logic), which is fed by
`data/` (Room + DataStore) and `service/`/`permission/` (Android-framework adapters), all wired
by hand in `MainActivity.kt` and `ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt` (`architecture_style_hint` from
repository inspection; no `Hilt`/`Koin`/`Dagger` dependency in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`).

### Directory layout

```
app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/
├── MainActivity.kt              # composition root: builds every concrete dependency once
├── ui/
│   ├── navigation/               # AppNavigation.kt — NavHost, routes, per-route wrapper composables
│   ├── ViewModelFactories.kt      # manual ViewModelProvider.Factory per screen (no DI)
│   ├── tracking/                  # TrackingScreen + TrackingViewModel + MapComponent
│   ├── history/                   # HistoryListScreen, SessionDetailScreen + their ViewModels
│   ├── newsession/                # NewSessionScreen + NewSessionViewModel
│   ├── settings/                  # SettingsScreen + SettingsViewModel
│   ├── export/                    # ExportFormatDialog
│   └── theme/                     # "Organic" design system (Color/Shape/Type/Theme.kt)
├── domain/
│   ├── session/                   # SessionController(Impl) — session lifecycle orchestration
│   ├── stats/                     # StatsEngine, DistanceCalculator, SegmentClassifier (pure)
│   ├── export/                    # ExportService, GpxExporter, CsvExporter
│   ├── geocoding/                 # FirstPointGeocodingCoordinator, ReverseGeocoder
│   ├── model/                     # SamplingInterval, GpsPrecision (closed enums)
│   └── units/                     # DistanceUnit/SpeedUnit + formatters (display-only conversions)
├── data/
│   ├── local/                     # AppDatabase, entity/, dao/ (Room)
│   └── settings/                  # SettingsRepository (DataStore Preferences)
├── service/                       # LocationForegroundService, LocationCollector,
│                                   # LocationForegroundServiceController, AndroidReverseGeocoder
└── permission/                    # LocationPermissionManager (grant-state checks only)
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| `ui/` | Compose screens, ViewModels, navigation graph, test tags, manual `ViewModelProvider.Factory` wiring | Business rules (sampling-interval validity, stop/move thresholds), persistence |
| `domain/` | Session lifecycle rules, stats math, export file formats, geocoding orchestration — mostly Android-framework-free and unit-testable | `Context`, Room/DataStore instances, Play Services APIs |
| `data/` | Room entities/DAOs/`AppDatabase`, DataStore-backed `SettingsRepository`/`UserSettings` | Business rules on the data (e.g. stop-radius/duration defaults come from `SegmentClassifier` constants, not redefined here) |
| `service/` | Android `Service` lifecycle, `FusedLocationProviderClient` adapter, `Intent`-based start/stop bridge | Point-acceptance/drift logic (delegated to `domain`-adjacent `LocationCollector`, which itself is Android-free aside from being in the `service` package) |
| `permission/` | Runtime permission grant-state checks (`ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`/`ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION`) | The permission *request* flow — that lives in `ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt`'s `NewSessionRoute` |

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| FusedLocationProviderClient | `service/LocationForegroundService.kt` — `FusedLocationSampleSource` | Priority derived from `GpsPrecision` via `toLocationRequestPriority()`, read once per session start |
| Google Maps SDK | `AndroidManifest.xml` meta-data `com.google.android.geo.API_KEY`, key sourced from `local.properties` `MAPS_API_KEY` (gitignored) | Placeholder `YOUR_API_KEY_HERE` used when the key is absent (`app/build.gradle.kts`) |
| `android.location.Geocoder` | `service/AndroidReverseGeocoder.kt` via `domain/geocoding/ReverseGeocoder` interface | Best-effort, no retry, failures swallowed by `FirstPointGeocodingCoordinator` |
| Room (SQLite) | `data/local/AppDatabase.kt` | Local-only persistence, `fallbackToDestructiveMigration()` |
| DataStore Preferences | `data/settings/SettingsRepository.kt` | Local-only user settings, memoized per file name |

### Macro flow: background GPS collection (async)

```
[NewSessionViewModel] --startSession(interval)--> [SessionControllerImpl]
        |                                                 |
        |                              1. checks isBackgroundLocationGranted()
        |                              2. inserts TrackingSessionEntity(ACTIVE)
        |                                                 |
        |                                                 v
        |                                   [LocationForegroundServiceController]
        |                                        --startForegroundService(Intent)-->
        |                                                 |
        |                                                 v
        |                                     [LocationForegroundService.onStartCommand]
        |                                        - startForeground() (immediate, before settings read)
        |                                        - reads GpsPrecision once from SettingsRepository
        |                                        - builds FusedLocationSampleSource + LocationCollector
        |                                                 |
        |                                                 v
        |                          [FusedLocationProviderClient] --LocationCallback--> [LocationCollector]
        |                                                 |            - guards: session active? permission?
        |                                                 |            - computes observedIntervalDriftMillis
        |                                                 |            - inserts GpsPointEntity via GpsPointDao
        |                                                 |            - fires onFirstPointRecorded (once)
        |                                                 v
        |                                  [FirstPointGeocodingCoordinator] --fire&forget-->
        |                                       [AndroidReverseGeocoder] --success--> updateLocationName()
        |
        v
[TrackingViewModel] <--Flow<List<GpsPointEntity>>-- [GpsPointDao.getPointsForSession]
        |  combine()'d with settingsRepository.userSettings --> live stats via StatsEngine
        v
  user taps "Finalizar" --stopSession(sessionId)--> [SessionControllerImpl]
        - stops service, reads final points
        - SegmentClassifier.classify() + StatsEngine --> persists FINISHED session
```
